[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T18:02:26Z, by staff] Slate Names Hillary Frey as New CEO
Slate, a digital news and culture magazine owned by Graham Holdings, has appointed editor-in-chief Hillary Frey as its new CEO.
Hillary Frey, who has served as editor-in-chief of Slate since 2022, has been named the company's new CEO, effective immediately. In this expanded role, Frey will oversee the business operations of the publication while continuing to lead its newsroom. The appointment was announced in a memo to staff from Tim O'Shaughnessy, CEO of Slate's parent company, Graham Holdings. This move reflects a broader industry trend of integrating editorial and revenue operations to support the sustainability of news organizations.
